statement: Mornington Racecourse Market runs on 14 June 2026, 9am to 2pm.
note: Written by hand because the migration held this record back: its verificationStatus reads "Updated after organiser cancellation notice", and the site's shared cancellation reader tests /cancelled/i, which "cancellation" does not match. Whether the series carries a cancellation is a separate editorial question and is not answered here.
